01_qubits.notes: Rewritten per the M4 standard. Qiskit 1.2.4 / qiskit-aer 0.16.0, seed 1234 (Z 521/503; X 1024/0; Ry 3099/997). 98/98 KaTeX expressions compile.

02_gates.notes: Rewritten. Verified H^2=I, H|1>=|->, Z/S/T = P(pi,pi/2,pi/4) up to global phase, RY(pi/3)->(0.8660,0.5000). Platform facts checked in source: PORTABLE_BASIS rx,ry,rz,cx; param allow-list.

03_entanglement.notes: Rewritten. Verified Bell amplitudes (0.7071,0,0,0.7071); counts 00/11 = 1022/1026 with 01/10 absent; GHZ 000/111 = 1009/1039; no-CNOT control gives 00/01.

04_measurement.notes: Rewritten. Forcing loop verified against the platform's own dynamic engine: counts {'0': 256}, while_cap_hits 0, while_cap 32. Limits cross-checked in config.py (15 qubits, 4096 shots).

10_gates_bootcamp.notes: Rewritten. Removed <details>/<summary> (rehype-raw not installed, so it rendered as escaped text); replaced with '### Answers'. Verified all 13 gate sections: counts for I/X/Y/SX/Sdg/Tdg, HZH->1, HTH->0.857 (theory 0.8536), SX^2=X, S=T^2, Z=S^2, Y=iXZ, SWAP=3 CNOTs, CCX->111. Corrected my own Exercise 6: |+> is a +1 eigenstate of SX.

05_deutsch_jozsa.notes: Rewritten. FIXED A CONTENT ERROR: the previous text claimed the 2-qubit example gives '1' every time; it gives '0', because the oracle target was in |+> (a +1 eigenstate of X) so there was no phase kickback. Corrected to prepare |-> via x(1) before h(1). Verified all four oracle types (balanced -> {'1':1024}; constant -> {'0':1024}) and n=2 (balanced XOR -> {'11':2048}; constant -> {'00':2048}).

08_dynamic_circuits.notes: Rewritten. FOCUS: the execution model and export behaviour. Verified is_dynamic() per construct: if=True, while=True, for=False, box=False, terminal measure=False, plain gates=False. Confirmed DYNAMIC_BACKENDS == ['qiskit_dynamic'] (one entry). Verified if/else counts {'00':276,'01':748} and that H^4=I. Cross-checked limits in config.py: 15 qubits, 4096 shots, while_cap 32, 8s/15s celery timeouts. Complements 12_control_flow (the blocks in detail) with cross-links both ways.

09_quantum_noise.notes: Rewritten. Verified against the platform's own Aer noise backend, not assumed: T2 clamped to 2*T1 (t1=5,t2=100 -> 10 with note); readout 15% gives counts {'00':791,'01':241,'10':255,'11':761} with fidelity 1.0000 and purity 1.0000; decoherence t1=5,t2=4 gives {'00':1049,'01':56,'10':73,'11':870} with fidelity 0.8645, purity 0.7586. CORRECTED A NUANCE: the 'purity bottoms out at 0.5' claim holds for pure DEPHASING (verified 0.5000 at t2=0.01), but strong T1 relaxation drives the state to pure |0>, returning purity to 1.0 at fidelity 0.5. Added a table showing both regimes. Virtual-Z list verified in noise.py.

12_control_flow.notes: Rewritten. FOCUS: the four blocks in detail, measurement semantics, limits. Verified the conditional-correction example on the dynamic engine: with if -> {'00':514,'01':510} (q1 always 0); without if -> {'00':514,'11':510} (q1 copies q0). Verified repeat-until-success: {'0':512}, while_cap_hits 0. Noted the OpenQASM 3 inclusive-slice gotcha (c[0:2] is three bits). Cross-linked to 08_dynamic_circuits.

13_classical_bit_vs_qubit.notes: Rewritten. Verified the three decisive circuits plus H,Z,H: H -> {'0':521,'1':503}; H,H -> {'0':1024}; H,meas,H -> {'0':509,'1':515}; H,Z,H -> {'1':1024}. The B-vs-C contrast (identical gates, different answers, separated only by a measurement) is the lesson's core argument and is now backed by real counts.

06_grover.notes: Rewritten. Verified N=4 marking |11>: 1 iteration -> {'11': 2048} (100%); 2 iterations -> {'00':530,'01':501,'10':517,'11':500} (over-rotation back to uniform); theta = 60 deg; CZ == (I x H) CX (I x H). CORRECTED MY OWN EXERCISE 5: the helper's marked-string was in qubit-index order while Qiskit bitstrings are qubit-0-rightmost, so grover(2,'01',1) returned {'10': 2048} not {'01': 2048}. Fixed the convention and guarded the empty X list.

11_bell_states.notes: Rewritten. Verified all four preparations: amplitudes, direct counts (Phi+/Phi- and Psi+/Psi- indistinguishable by counts) and Bell-basis measurement after inverting the preparation (00/01/10/11, each 1024/1024 deterministic). Noted that the alternative Psi- convention differs only by a global phase.

07_vqe_qaoa.notes: Rewritten. Ran a real VQE: for H = 1.0 ZZ + 0.5 XI + 0.3 ZI the exact ground energy is -1.392839 and COBYLA converged to -1.392838, approaching from above as the variational principle requires. Verified the basis-change recipes: X = H before measuring; Y = Sdg then H (Y eigenstates become deterministic). Documented that the platform's numeric-only parameters limit the Composer to single landscape points rather than full loops.
